meta.name: apple-hig-expert
meta.description: Audits and designs iOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS interfaces against the Apple Human Interface Guidelines, including the Liquid Glass design language (announced WWDC25, shipped with iOS 26/macOS Tahoe, Sept 2025). Use when reviewing an Apple-platform mockup or app for HIG compliance, checking contrast or tap-target sizes, or designing native-feeling Apple UI (e.g., 'audit my iOS app against the HIG', 'is this text readable on Liquid Glass?').

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照苹果人机界面指南审核和设计各平台界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为苹果平台设计或审核界面，需要确保符合HIG规范。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and design Apple platform interfaces against HIG guidelines.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing Apple platform interfaces and need HIG compliance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会依据苹果人机界面指南（HIG）审核和设计 iOS、macOS、watchOS、visionOS 的界面，包括 Liquid Glass 设计语言。它能检查对比度、点击目标大小，并给出合规报告。
howto.when: 当你要求审核苹果平台的设计稿或应用是否符合 HIG，或询问 Liquid Glass 设计语言时触发。例如说“审核我的 iOS 应用是否符合 HIG”或“这段文字在 Liquid Glass 上可读吗？”。

say.text: 审核我的 iOS 应用界面是否符合 HIG。
say.note: Claude 会运行合规检查并给出评分报告。

say.text: 检查这个按钮的点击区域是否足够大。
say.note: Claude 会测量尺寸并对比 44x44 pt 标准。

say.text: 这段文字在 Liquid Glass 背景上对比度够吗？
say.note: Claude 会计算对比度并给出通过/失败结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits and designs iOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS interfaces against the Apple Human Interface Guidelines, including the Liquid Glass design language. It checks contrast ratios, tap-target sizes, and delivers compliance reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review an Apple-platform mockup or app for HIG compliance, or inquire about Liquid Glass design language. For example, 'audit my iOS app against the HIG' or 'is this text readable on Liquid Glass?'.

say_en.text: Audit my iOS app interface against the HIG.
say_en.note: Claude runs compliance checks and provides a score report.

say_en.text: Check if this button's tap target is large enough.
say_en.note: Claude measures size and compares to the 44x44 pt minimum.

say_en.text: Is this text readable on a Liquid Glass background?
say_en.note: Claude calculates contrast ratio and reports pass/fail.
